before: Terrain stores raw copy-window bytes; every probe recomputes source row/byte-column offsets, unpacks triangle controls and reads neighbor controls. WheelSamples encodes blocked direction as direction+1.
after_plan: Decode an atlas of native geometry/triangle/material patches for every byte-aligned source view. Compile source row/column aliases into immutable coordinate-to-patch views at SamplingTables loading. Predecode ordered block escape decisions, preserve query-time unsupported/missing geometry errors and source integer interpolation. Pass optional native BlockDirection values to motion instead of encoded flags.
source_probe_findings: Y-high doubled at byte width selects row(y_high&127); only row selectors0..43 are supported. Each of256 X-high values selects a wrapped3*column byte view, not a regular grid column.
44 row words and256 column views cover5932 distinct start offsets with original tables; many final-edge views lack full geometry. Custom row-word addition wraps before indexing.

Complete geometry requires bytes through index+135. Lower/right neighbor controls are index+134/index+5, so are necessarily available whenever geometry is. Left/upper negative offsets are at least-130 and fall entirely within the explicit configured preceding-control policy. Thus neighbor errors are unreachable after valid geometry under the current source/native copy-window contract; keep ordered first-opening selection and document this bound rather than invent missing neighbors.

Initialization/suspension and pair separation share the query. Preserve per-wheel3->0 and pair current->other marker-history ordering, retained blocked-wheel heights, ones-complement reflection and track8 bias.
